{{Top|leg}}
'''The Bazaar''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|yearly]] event held in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cjaalysce'I]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. A [[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long event, Cjaalysce'I welcomed around 15,000 beings for a celebration including traditional Old [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] food and drink. [[Merchant/Legends|Merchants]] sold art, souvenirs, clothing, food and jewelry.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
